nom: cocokind Daily SPF 32 Mineral Facial Sunscreen

avis.texte: I have enjoyed cocokind's electrolyte line, thought I'd give their mineral sunscreen a try. I appreciate their formulation in avoiding silicone based ingredients but the initial finish of this sunscreen is way too heavy, heavy satin and white cast-y finish. I have to say it gets better with time, a hour after the heavy initial finish, it got better. I have decided I won't be putting up with this as there are always better choices. Wanted something that is comfortable right off the bat. This would be nice perhaps for the super dry and pale skin in a low humid condition.
Perfect base for my makeup, helps everything stay in place while keeping my face safe from the sun.

as someone who hates sunscreen, but still terrified of the future of my skin haha, this is finally one I can put on and actually look forward to putting on. the smell isn't strong, it's lightweight and does not put a purple/white cast on my tan complexion, and my skin did not react to it. highly recommend for anyone who is guilty on skipping the spf because they hate sunscreen; this is your girl!

The bottle is small, it leaves the most terrible white cast. I am white, olive skin tone, the white cast does not blend in and takes a while to go away. If you're a person of color I would NOT recommend this product. It also burns around the eyes. It also dries quite fast so you don't have enough time to spread it around your face. Not worth the money there are better mineral sunscreens out there.

White cast leaving my skin with a pale, purple tint. My skin looks slightly greasy too. I expected a better mineral sunscreen for the price, other brands do it better for sure. Giving it 3 stars because it does it's job as a sunscreen

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: A little goes a long way! Initially I felt like it was such a small amount that wouldnt last long but the product spreads very well and for using a fingertip amount I feel like it gives great coverage. Ive been using it once a day for a month and I still have half the tube left.

I have repurchased this suncreen countless times! It's lightweight and does not leave my skin looking oily. It also does not have a strong sunscreen smell, which is always a plus for me. Will continue to repurchase this product < 3

I have tried so many sunscreens for my face that leave a white cast and don't do the job! This sunscreen is the only one that I've tried that does NOT leave the white cast (as long as you rub it in!) and does a great job protecting my skin. I used this on our Caribbean cruise this winter and it worked perfectly, I did not get a sunburn at all but still got a healthy glow with my tan! I use this product EVERY day no matter the weather.
I wanted to love this and it looks great the first few minutes but it starts to pill if you even graze your face (no makeup) after it dries.

Just purchased and applied for the first time and it goes on like a dream. Will be using it this summer as my go to, hopefully with good results! I feel like itll be a great base under makeup with how creamy and evenly it applies!
I use this daily! I like the texture and weight of it, and it never bothers my eyes.

I am super picky about my sunscreen but I love this one! A lot of mineral sunscreens on the market will include chemical filters in their formulas that are not FDA-regulated in order to increase the SPF but they don't have to list them as an active ingredient. This one does not do that, it is 100% mineral which I love. It is very lightweight, does not cause breakouts, and feels great on the skin. It does leave a bit of a white cast which is unavoidable so I just mix in bronzing drops, which I'm happy to do as a compromise for using mineral sunscreen. The only concern is the amount you get for the price, so I would just be sure to try and purchase it on sale if possible.
Love this mineral sunscreen! Its not too thick like other brands. Its rubs in mostly clear and makes my skin feel well hydrated.

Will be returing. Left a very noticeable white cast no matter how little of the product I used. It also felt extremely heavy, like my skin was suffocating, I tried to give it a chance for a few hours but had to wash it off. I went with this product for the clean ingredients and cocokind usually has good products that i gravitate to.
I think this is the best sunscreen I have ever used as a fair-complexed redhead with sensitive skin!

i always read reviews but still like to make my own mind up about a product so i bought this and although i loveee this brand and their clean ingredients, this does leave a white cast babes. its not crazy but i noticed it. im returning it :(

This is a great moisturizing and non irritating formula. BUT there is definitely a white cast… im already fair and it makes me look washed out. It does settle some. The white cast does settle.. but its mostly the unbreathable feeling i dislike. I can feel sweat is trapped and cant get puror something? Overall I like the pros…. But wont repurchase

avis.titre: if you are pale or poc, no
avis.texte: i am a very pale girl, the lightest shade in all complextion makeup products (sometimes they are too orange for me). but this sunscreen gave me whitecast and made me look even more like casper the friendly ghost. white cast aside the formula isnt bad for american spf, but i would recommend you use a korean spf instead. if you are poc pls know this product will probably be extremely white cast on you.

Nice lightweight spf that doesnt have any of the fillers or other concerning sunscreen ingredients. I started wearing it every day this winter. 4 stars as it did seem to rub off more with swimming and in harsher sun, so maybe not the best sport sunscreen option.

Starting on my clean ingredient, no toxin journey and I was searching for a SPF for daily use. I was looking for a SPF without titanium dioxide, and I found it! Many SPFs break me out, and let me tell you I have no hesitation putting this on every morning. My skin has been great and I have no remorse when putting this on my face. Would recommend this SPF to everyone.

I love this sunscreen, it's helped my skin a lot. The only reason it didn't get 5 stars was bc of the white cast. I'm white with olive skin tone and it turns me into Nosferatu. It fades but it's there. If you're a poc I wouldn't recommend this product.

I love the ingredients and the brand, but I can't seem to rub this in enough to get rid of the slight white cast, so I don't use it as my daily sunscreen ( bring back the chemical formula, please!) BUT, it is PERFECT after Microneedling, and I imagine, it would work after lasers and other treatments, when you absolutely must wear sunscreen, you can't afford to miss a spot, but you need soothing ingredients (aloe, dipotassium glycyrrhizate, and vit e). Obviously, check with your doc (I'm always told nothing for the first 24 hours), but as a post-procedure SPF, this wins.

This is one of my sneaky Cocokind favorites! Not only do I love it as an SPF, but my little hack is I've found my makeup lasts FAR longer when I use this SPF than when I don't. Pro tip: If you're worried about texture or a white cast, just apply with less product at a time rather than in a larger glob.

It does leave a very visible white cast that doesn't really fade. The only reason I'm not rating it lower is because it's very hard for me to find a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin and isn't too drying. I'll just use it as an indoor sunscreen so no one has to see me wearing it lol. Wouldn't repurchase

This is my first time using this product, i am impressed! Its really hard to find "clean" sunscreen and this is now my new go to! I used to wear the First Aid Beauty sunscreen however they changed the formula, ugh. This sunscreen is very similar in texture! I like how its not watery however still blends great. Give this a try!

I really love this product. In todays market finding a sunscreen thats non toxic and has great performance seams like a challenge. Cocokinds daily spf completed the task! I hope in the future we'll have only organic ingredients in the formulation but as of now is one of the best out there

This was the first CocoKind product I tried, and let's just say I was hooked! I have dry, sensitive skin, and I live at high altitude. This SPF is the best for protection, hydration, and it gives my skin a nice glow- bonus! It goes on smoothly (a little goes a long way), does not create a zombie white cast, and it does not pill when used on top of other products or under make-up. Despite being hydrating, it does not feel occlusive or greasy at all; you get a nice glow, but don't turn out shiny. Great product- I hope they make it forever!
Gives my skin a dewy, smooth look without white cast. I've loved mixing it with my liquid foundation when I want light color correction and coverage
My favorite sunscreen that I've used for years was discontinued so I really wanted to love this one. Unfortunately it pills so much. I even tried it with multiple different moisturizers but no luck.

I use this product daily, especially when using my retinol. It's lightweight and a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts a long time. The Daily SPF eeps my skin hydrated throughout the day, so typically I don't apply a moisturizer when I've already applied the SPF.
Been using this SPF for years and I'll never use another! Provides coverage without feeling heavy or oily. One of my favorite cocokind products :)
This is a must. I use it everyday and does not irritate my skin.
I use this sunscreen everyday! Its the last step in my routine and i find it to be so moisturizing but not oily
I love this sunscreen! Its light weight, doesn't smell or leave a white residue. It doesn't feel like you are wearing sunscreen and works well under make up and for everyday use!
very bad white cast and im very white (briefly worked like a foundation fresh out of winter) good formula otherwise

Loving this SPF Facial Suncreen! It goes on easily and doesnt make my face feel greasy. It absorbs well. I have been using it alone without makeup on vacation as well as applying it before I do my makeup.

I absolutely love this sunscreen. It melts into your skin so wonderfully. I can wear this under makeup and I don't have to worry about it pilling or peeling, I recommend this SPF to all of my friends.
This is literally one of my favorite SPFs to use. It goes on well under my makeup or stand alone. It doesn't smell like sunscreen and doesn't leave a white mark!
I love this sunscreen, it feel so good to put on. It is mineral and the texture is truly radiant. I haven't burned this summer and I am OUTSIDE. I will absolutely buy again

avis.titre: All Mineral Sunscreens have a cast. This is THE best of them
avis.texte: Alll mineral sunscreens will leave a cast on brown skin, but I still LOVE this sunscreen. I have super sensitive skin and have tried a dozen mineral sunscreens looking for something my skin will tolerate. This leaves the least amount of cast and doesn't send my skin into a tizzy. Please, please: change nothing. And for those who want a cast-free sunscreen, look into chemical or something with more emollients. Leave this one alone as one of the few I can tolerate. It goes on well, is a fab primer/ base for my mineral makeup and doesn't leave me with angry red bumps and an itchy face.

Very good sunscreen, it works for my acne prone skin and is also very moisturizing. Especially if you have dry skin. This also gets a good rating on the Yuka app which lets me rest at peace. I also appreciate the sustainability features.

This sunscreen does not work well for my skin during the summer months. The texture is initially very smooth and the consistency is like a thicker face moisturizer. It appears to absorb well after initial application, but even the smallest amount of face sweat will cancel out what had absorbed! So my face is left a greasy, sweaty, goopy mess. I tried multiple ways applying this, even going so far as using ONLY this sunscreen in the morning after washing my face (skipping actives and a lightweight moisturizer, which is my usual), with the same messy result when my face sweats. It does work better in the cooler months when there's less face sweat. I ended up using the rest of this tube on my body.
Very sticky and greasy. It didn't feel like it fully absorbed into my skin for several hours after applying, and honestly that may have just been it wearing off.

I really wanted to like this sunscreen. I purchased one three years ago, and I immediately found that it had ten times more of a white cast than promised. This pills whether or not I'm wearing makeup. As a brown girlie, I am constantly on the hunt for a good spf that doesn't leave a white cast. I must say, I'm very upset that cocokind discontinued the silk spf (the one in the purple tube). I really love this brand and have multiple other products from them. Hopefully one day they have another better spf too :)

I really like the thickness of this sunscreen. It doesn't leave your skin feeling oily and absorbs quickly. It also has a nice scent and doesn't smell like sunscreen. I wear it under makeup and it's perfect! I will Def purchase again!

I wanted to like this sunscreen, but it's too sticky and dries out my skin. I don't recommend this for anyone with combo + acne prone skin. Also not a good product for layering makeup over, it will pill.
Does not burn your eyes! Easy application and melts into skin with other products.
i can't believe this doesn't have a white cast as a mineral spf?! i have always been picky about what spf i buy because most of them don't work on my tan skin but this leaves a great pearlized glow
A clean spf!!! No icky chemicals in this one!! My daughter likes it.

I wanted to try a new, clean, sunscreen for my daily routine. This product is really good and lightweight on the skin. It makes my face feel very soft and look very hydrated. Really recommend this product!!

I can only use mineral sunscreen because of sensitive eyes and skin, and this one is great! I've tried so many sunscreens and this is one that absorbs into my skin the best out of the few I currently use. It doesn't feel heavy! It doesnt have an odor of any kind, which is also nice. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I will say, it does leave a slight white cast but I have fair skin so it isn't extremely noticeble. If you have a medium/deep skin tone I would suggest passing on this sunscreen. Overall it works fantastic for me and I will continue to repurchase :)
Love how easy the spf goes on and feels, as week as, the daily protection!

I definitely trust the formulation of this product, but even as someone with very pale skin, I do get a white-cast from this SPF. Maybe it's because I have a lot of redness in my face. I've preferred the Silk SPF (purple packaging) for the past couple years and was disappointed to see it's not available anymore.

This is my favorite lightweight mineral based SPF I've found! It doesn't leave a white cast on my skin and my makeup doesn't have any issues being layered over it when doing a water based makeup routine!! One of my new favorite additions to my routine
I love this sunscreen! It doesn't leave a white cast on my skin like other mineral sunscreens that I have tried. It also doesn't leave my skin feeling overly oily.

This sunscreen feels so great on! It blends in really well, which for a mineral sunscreen is hard to find sometimes. It is hydrating but not greasy and dries down really well with no white cast. This will be my go to SPF this summer!
Love this SPF! It's not oily or drying and it doesn't make my makeup all weird if I use this SPF to prep my skin beforehand
Lightweight and doesn't give me a white cast like other SPFs! It makes my skin super glowy and hydrated all day long!

This may be my FAVORITE cocokind product. I've been using this daily for years and can't go a day without it. It makes my skin so glowy and hydrated. You NEED this!! I have multiple at a time so I never run out

I really appreciated when Cocokind came out with this SPF! Sunscreens can be tricky, but I trust this one so much that I started to use it on my daughter (now two) the first summer after she was born.
My favorite spf for daily use. I wish it came tinted, but it's still my favorite! It layers really well with my other skincare products.
I have oily, acne prone skin and after wearing this sunscreen all day it made my skin look really oily. I recently purchased the Beauty of Josen Suncreen and its a lot better for oily skin.
This is one of my favorite products, great sunscreen not super thick, also moisturizing!

avis.titre: great texture / performance. slight white cast
avis.texte: the texture is great, and works well under makeup. only leaving off one star because it does have a slight white cast that is tougher to blend in on darker skin tones.

It's ok. It's a bit too thick for my liking. Rather get a lighter sunscreen that's easier to blend. Also, a pretty small size for the price, I think I might not even get a month's use out of the bottle.

avis.titre: Isn't very kind with the whitecast
avis.texte: Makes me look like a ghost. Leaves a very bad white cast and does not melt in, unless you rub your face for 20 minutes. It also pills under make up and makes it uneven. Not very impressive and very disappointing for all the claims.

I like this sunscreen, but I wont be repurchasing it. You really have to work it into the skin, even then there is still a slight white cast. It also leaves a tacky texture on the skin for hours after application.

avis.titre: Too thick, white and hard to rub in
avis.texte: Received this as a gift from my mom and really don't like it- it feels thick and is difficult to rub in. Leaves a white cast even after rubbing in quite a lot which irritates my skin. Wish I could trade it it for something else.

avis.titre: The BEST clean SPF cream Iâ€™ve found!
avis.texte: Love this! I live at the beach and use this year round to protect my skin. Rubs in perfectly and great base for makeup. I have tried so many clean SPF creams and this is hands down THE best! Great price too.

this is the only sunscreen I've tried that I can wear under makeup that doesn't give my eyes an allergic reaction. it is a bit oily and if you don't fully rub it in it can leave a white cast. if you have sensitive eyes I highly recommend this. just be intentional about rubbing it in and you'll be fine. starts off oily but it doesn't leave my skin any more oily at the end of the day and the oil soaks into my skin after around 10-15 minutes.
Wonderful sunscreen. Doesn't feel too oily or leave your skin dry.
I love this but it makes my skin feel kinda oily. I use it sometimes when i am getting my nails done and it moisterizes my hands more than my face lol!!!
I love this but it makes my skin feel kinda oily. I use it sometimes when i am getting my nails done and it moisterizes my hands more than my face lol!!!
love that cocokind has spf products available, however the white cast makes me not want to reach for it as much as I should. does get a bit chalky on my skin as well.

avis.titre: Gives your face a chalky appearance
avis.texte: tried this spf and wasn't a fan. It's very chalky and requires a lot of rubbing to absorb into my face after it dries leaves a chalky appearance.
Applies smoothly. No pilling when applied over serum or during the application of make up..

I was so excited to try this sunscreen and was immediately disappointed. I always do at least two fingers worth of SPF to cover face and neck but it was so thick and difficult to blend in that it took me at least 5- 10 minutes to get it to where I did not look like a ghost. My skin is a light tan so the claim that there is no white cast is crazy to me.
I love this product and use it daily! It's thick but still feels lightweight. I have replaced my Cetaphil daily sunscreen with this one.
It takes time to run in, if you don't it will race a white cast. I appreciate the quality ingredients and I feel good about putting this on my face! Does not cause breakouts for me.

avis.titre: Didn't live up to the hype
avis.texte: I wanted to like this so badly after seeing all the raving reviews but it's not for me. I learned very quickly that you can't layer this over moisturizer but it seems fine under makeup. It takes some intense rubbing to remove the white cast when you first put it on which is to be expected for a mineral sunscreen. My biggest complaint is that I can smell it on my face ALL day. It doesn't smell bad but I don't want to smell my face sunscreen all day! Will not be repurchasing.
The best sunscreen out there! It absorbs well and protects as it should. My favorite!
Love this sunscreen! Very lightweight & doesn't aggravate my acne prone sensitive skin.
I will not buy again and won't finish the tube. It smells synthetic and the texture leaves my skin feeling clogged and tacky.
Love this SPF! Feels so lightweight in my skin and does not make me oily!!

As an exceptionally fair-skinned redhead amongst redheads, I was shocked that I struggled with the white cast of this product. I LOVE cocokind & wanted to love it. My fine lines had white cast stuck in them. I looked like a greasy Casper
Medium skin, slight white cast and some irritation to the eyes when sweaty. Overall great protection and wearability
It goes on smooth, doesn't leave a white cast, doesn't feel sticky or uncomfortable, and doesn't break me out. I have tried countless other brands but this is the one I keep going back to.
Pretty good quality. Little thicker than I would like and doesn't go on smooth. Also causes irritation to the eyes.
ingredients are not acne safe - usually love this brand for its noncomedogenic ingredients but this one does not pass the test sadly ):
I love this formula. It goes on smooth and doesn't irritate my skin.

I swear by this sunscreen and have given it as a gift. The friends and family that have been gifted this have stated that they too love it. The best think aside from the easy application with no white cast is that even when you sweat it doesnt burn
I love that it's FULL coverage without feeling greasy. It's light on the skin while still providing the benefits of strong UV protection.
feels nice, doesn't leave white cast (although I am very pale). I've had skin cancer before so I wear this often - repeat buyer
great for sensitive skin!!! i've never met a sunscreen before this one that doesn't break me out in hives, but i love this bottle :)
Great sunscreen that blends in easily and leaves a Dewey glow

This is my go to sunscreen. It feels nice on my face, it definitely protects me from the sun and I live in LA so I definitely need protection everyday. I feel like I get a lot of product for the size. I have pretty normal skin and it hasnt made me breakout or get too dry or oily.

This SPF is amazing. I feel as though Ive tried every mineral SPF on the market over the years and this beats them all, hands down. Ive been using it for two weeks now and my sensitive skin has had no reaction. I love that it doesnt smell like an SPF, and it so well over my moisturizer and other skin care!

i love this spf !! it layers nicely on top of my moisturizer and leaves my skin glowy and not greasy, and it is easy to reapply throughout the day. I just wish this bottle was bigger because i go through it so much!
Ive always used the silk sunscreen but wanted to try the all zinc one. I wasnt prepared to love it so much! No white cast and it goes on so smoothly.

This facial sunscreen is the best, I have dry acne-prone skin and this doesnt break me out. It does leave a white cast on my medium skin tone, so becareful with the amount that you use. But its isnt as noticeable unless youre lathering on your face. A little goes a long way!

This is the best spf I've ever used. Sooo soft and light l, no oily casts on face. I used mineral spf from other brand and every time it was so stressful to wipe all the white cast, my face git sweety casue I hadn't such problems. But this spf is simply amazing, it gives soft tone and higlights face so nice. The is only things is its size, I'd like to see it in 100ml. 100% reccomended!!!
Love this sunscreen. I re apply two to three times a day and there is no cast. Makes my skin glow and feels great âœ¨
Was excited to find a SPF that I could make part of my skincare routine. Lightweight and not greasy.
It's works well, blends in well but does leave a bit of a white cast
It blends in well and does it's job. But don't get it wet! Will burn eyes
Little pricey for the size, but it doesn't burn my eyes, and that's about all I can ask for. I don't know how well make up sites on it, but my Freck cream blush seems fine.

very basic sunscreen, a little greasy, leaves a white cast, feels nice on skin though, it sits on top for a very long time (i think that's good for this kind of sunscreen), a little goes a long way for this product

I started using this sunscreen a year ago and I have never looked back! I have very sensitive, combo skin and this spf does not irritate me at all! When it initially goes on, there is a slight white cast, but it quickly goes away if you continue to rub on the skin. Love this moisturizer/spf combo and could not recommend it more, will definitely continue to repurchase.

I'd been looking for a mineral sunscreen with an effective percentage of zinc oxide (20% or more) and this is it. It goes on easily, absorbs quickly with hardly any white cast, feels good, and isn't sticky or itchy like other sunscreens. I definitely recommend!
This is the best spf I've ever used. Smooth and lightweight. Not at all greasy.

avis.titre: The facial SPF that puts all other facials SPFs to shame.
avis.texte: This SPF was my third purchase of facial SPF this summer and I FEEL LIKE I HAVE FOUND ~the one~. Other brands have either too oily or too matte an appearance that clogged my pores and made me self-conscious about the size of my pores/sebaceous filaments. Cocokind knocked all of those other brands out of the park. Especially with the price point. I am recommending this product to all of my family, friends and customers. I feel like it truly works and I can't wait to move forward with it in the future (I am on week two).
My fav sunscreen!!! Leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowy. Will repurchase till I die.
I love the ingredients, feel and effectiveness of this spf. It's cleaner than other brands and leaves no sticky spf feeling on skin. Perfect for daily wear!!

avis.titre: This is my go to facial sunscreen!
avis.texte: This is the first face sunscreen that hasn't irritated my face and gets the job done. I've been using it for 6 months now and I've seen an improvement compared to my old facial sunscreen

It leaves a white cast and i have medium tan skintone. After a while the cast will blend out but it still looks like my face is a shade lighter. It feels thick on the skin and feels a bit tacky all day. Be sure to avoid getting it on your hairline. My first attempt at buying this bottle, it was only filled half way so i contacted support to exchange it. The second bottle was more filled. Over all my experience with this particular product is a no go. There are better sunscreens out there for the same price.
